instructions.title: Review Habitat Status, Life Support, and Emergency Information
instructions.message: Begin with the Habitat status displays.
instructions.guidance: Review the available overview, life-support, and emergency information together. Inspect their related records and logs, then record what the evidence supports and note uncertainty or unavailable data.

destination.name: Habitat Main Monitoring Area
destination.section: Status, Life Support, and Emergency Views

instructions.activity: Use the existing Habitat monitor and submit one combined status investigation.

instructions.title: Inspect Water and Nutrition Systems
instructions.message: Proceed to the Habitat water and nutrition station.
instructions.guidance: Review the available system status, procedure, and inspection logs. Base your conclusion only on supplied records.
instructions.activity: Approach the existing station interaction point, open its interface, and submit the investigation.

instructions.title: Inspect Engineering Monitoring
instructions.message: Continue to the Engineering monitoring section.
instructions.guidance: Review the available indicators, operational information, and monitoring logs. Record relevant observations.
instructions.activity: Approach the existing section interaction point and submit the monitoring review.

instructions.title: Investigate the Power Unit
instructions.message: Proceed to the Engineering power section.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the available power status, procedures, and logs. Compare readings with limits only when the records provide them, then explain and submit your conclusion.
instructions.activity: Approach the existing power workstation interaction point and submit the evidence-linked investigation.

instructions.title: Inspect Engineering Life Support
instructions.message: Review the Engineering life support section.
instructions.guidance: Read the available operating procedure and records, then document a conclusion that reflects the evidence and its limitations.
instructions.activity: Use the existing Engineering life-support interface and submit the investigation.

instructions.title: Review Engineering Diagnostics
instructions.message: Continue to the Engineering diagnostics workstation.
instructions.guidance: Review the available diagnostic procedure, test information, and logs. Missing diagnostic data is not itself proof of a fault.
instructions.activity: Use the existing diagnostics interface and submit your assessment.

instructions.title: Submit the Outpost Readiness Assessment
instructions.message: Review the inspection records and prepare the readiness assessment.
instructions.guidance: Reference the submitted inspection evidence, identify unresolved concerns, and choose a readiness conclusion supported by the records.
instructions.activity: Submit the final readiness assessment with its supporting record references.

completion.title: Sol 2 Required Activities Complete
completion.message: All mandatory Sol 2 activities are complete. Return to the Habitat Rest Area and use the existing rest interaction to conclude the Sol.
